doctors.name: Dr. Akansha Sharma
doctors.qualification: BDS, MDS - Oral & Maxillofacial Implantology (Gold Medalist)
doctors.bio: Specialist in immediate dental implants, full-arch restorations, and advanced bone grafting with over 14 years of surgical mastery.
doctors.detailedBio: Dr. Akansha Sharma is the Chief Medical Director and Senior Implantologist at Akansha Dental Clinic. With over 14 years of clinical excellence and international fellowship in computer-guided implantology, she has successfully performed more than 4,500 dental implant surgeries and full-mouth rehabilitations. Her clinical practice focuses on immediate-load implants, sinus lifts, piezo-bone surgery, and smile redesigning. She believes in empathetic, evidence-based dentistry, ensuring that every patient receives minimally invasive surgical care within an ultra-sterile, Class-B autoclave operating room.
doctors.scheduleText: Monday to Saturday (Morning: 10:00 AM - 01:30 PM | Evening: 05:00 PM - 08:30 PM). Sunday by prior appointment.

doctors.name: Dr. Rajesh Deshmukh
doctors.bio: Expert in painless single-sitting root canal treatments, smile redesigns, and tooth-colored composite restorations.
doctors.detailedBio: Dr. Rajesh Deshmukh is our Senior Endodontist recognized for his delicate touch and expertise in high-magnification dental microscopy. Having treated over 6,000 complex root canal cases, he specializes in single-visit painless RCTs, re-treatments of failed canals, separated instrument retrieval, and vital pulp therapy. His clinical philosophy centers on tooth conservation, avoiding unnecessary extractions wherever natural dentition can be biologically preserved.
doctors.scheduleText: Monday to Saturday (Morning: 10:30 AM - 02:00 PM | Evening: 05:30 PM - 08:30 PM)

doctors.name: Dr. Neha Kapoor
doctors.bio: Certified invisalign and self-ligating braces specialist transforming patient smiles with discreet modern aligners.
doctors.detailedBio: Dr. Neha Kapoor is a certified invisible aligner practitioner and specialist in dentofacial orthopedics. Over the past 9 years, she has corrected hundreds of complex malocclusions, deep bites, and open bites in teens and adults. Utilizing advanced 3D intraoral digital scanners, she provides patients with simulated before-and-after smile projections before treatment even starts, achieving discreet and predictable teeth alignment.
doctors.scheduleText: Monday to Saturday (Morning: 11:00 AM - 02:00 PM | Evening: 04:30 PM - 08:00 PM)

doctors.name: Dr. Amit Patel
doctors.department: Department of Periodontics & Laser Gum Care
doctors.bio: Laser gum surgery, dental bone regeneration, deep periodontal therapy, and aesthetic crown lengthening.
doctors.detailedBio: Dr. Amit Patel is an accomplished Periodontist specializing in minimally invasive diode laser surgery and bone regenerative therapy. He treats bleeding gums, severe pyorrhea, tooth mobility, and peri-implantitis. He emphasizes preventive periodontal therapy and uses fine ultrasonic piezo scalers and dental lasers that eliminate bacteria without requiring painful traditional gum incisions.
